instruction: Enable Sticky Keys, open File Explorer, create a folder called ProjectDocs on the Desktop, and move the three text files from the Desktop into the ProjectDocs folder using keyboard shortcuts.
gt_steps: Enable Sticky Keys from Windows accessibility settings.
Open File Explorer and go to the Desktop.
Create a new folder named ProjectDocs on the Desktop.
Use keyboard shortcuts to cut or move the selected files.
Paste or move the three text files into the ProjectDocs folder.

command:
echo File 1 > C:\Users\Docker\Desktop
otes1.txt && echo File 2 > C:\Users\Docker\Desktop
otes2.txt && echo File 3 > C:\Users\Docker\Desktop
otes3.txt

result.command:
cmd /c if exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\ProjectDocs
otes1.txt if exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\ProjectDocs
otes2.txt if exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\ProjectDocs
otes3.txt echo SUCCESS
